Three other players are visible around the badminton court. One is relatively close on the camera wearer’s right, facing inward with a racket; the others are farther away across or near the net, oriented toward the court. The shuttlecock is on the floor near the net and within easy retrieval distance. No person blocks the return path across the net, and the players appear to be waiting for play to resume. The socially appropriate action is therefore to return the shuttlecock to person Z.
